name: gc-minimal-ip-doodle
title_zh: 把IP角色重绘成极简手绘贴纸，保持身份一致
tagline_zh: 青蛙、水豚、吉祥物……一张参考图变五张不重样的冷淡风贴纸。浅色底、轻颗粒，手绘感统一，角色还是那个角色。
tagline_en: Turn a frog, capybara, or mascot into 5 deadpan sticker doodles. Flat, grainy, light background — same character.
desc_en: Preserve an IP character's identity while redrawing it as a sparse, flat, hand-drawn sticker illustration on white or a light grainy background. Use for requests such as "把这个角色做成极简手绘风格", "生成五张不同生活场景", "做一个浅色背景轻颗粒版", "再来五张不要重复", or when a frog, capybara, fish, mascot, toy, or other character reference must become a consistent batch of cute deadpan doodles.
why_zh: 不是简单换滤镜，而是先提取角色身份锚点，再在稀疏线条和扁平涂色中重建，保证每张都像同一个角色在不同场景。
why_en: It extracts identity anchors first, then rebuilds in sparse lines and flat fills — so every doodle feels like the same.
limit_zh: 只吃单角色参考图，多角色会糊。只出静态贴纸，不做动画或场景透视。背景必须是白或浅色颗粒，深色底会直接失败。
limit_en: Single-character reference only; multi-character blurs. Static stickers only — no animation or perspective. White/light grainy bg required; dark bg.
title_en: Redraw an IP character as minimal hand-drawn stickers.
